title: PHANIVIECATION 2N1 MO (04–05/06/2026)
summary: TODAYOURIST is pleased to join the group of students at the Cloud River Minor School on the tour – a pleasure-free and laughter in the beautiful sea city of Phan Tei.

content.text: TODAYOURIST is pleased to join the group of students at the Cloud River Minor School on the tour – a pleasure-free and laughter in the beautiful sea city of Phan Tei.
Check-in the popular views of Phan Iron with many beautiful angles
Free to bathe the sea, relax and enjoy the fresh sea air
Joining the dynamic Team Building on the beach, increasing the collective spirit and bond
Arriving in the fresh air with many traffic activities and memorable moments
Discovering the White Quot – the destination is likened to “the desert of Ping Shun
Archive beautiful moments with colleagues during the journey
Enjoy the local food and delicious seafood
Buy Phan Specials as a Gift for Family and Family
To TODAYURIST honors the teacher to always have so much health, joy, and so much more happy memories after this journey!
